mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_preference(profile_id,preferred_regions,accepted_org_levels,excluded_org_levels,preferred_subject_groups,accept_extra_subjects,prefer_more_recruits,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{profileId},#{preferredRegions},#{acceptedOrgLevels},#{excludedOrgLevels},#{preferredSubjectGroups},#{acceptExtraSubjects},#{preferMoreRecruits},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE preferred_regions=VALUES(preferred_regions),accepted_org_levels=VALUES(accepted_org_levels),excluded_org_levels=VALUES(excluded_org_levels),preferred_subject_groups=VALUES(preferred_subject_groups),accept_extra_subjects=VALUES(accept_extra_subjects),prefer_more_recruits=VALUES(prefer_more_recruits),updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
